name: signature_v1
model: clinical (unpenalised) + elastic-net Cox on RNA genes shared by TCGA, GPL570 and GPL96

rna.scale_note: TCGA log2(CPM+1); arrays: log2(x+1), highest-mean probe per gene, per-gene z-score within cohort

external_plan.primary: GSE31210, all 226 tumours (OS); sensitivity: 204 without flagged incomplete resection/adjuvant therapy
external_plan.secondary: GSE68465, 442 adenocarcinomas (OS; stage derived from pT/pN, no stage IV)
external_plan.scoring: frozen coefficients; no refitting, tuning, or threshold search on external data
external_plan.success: Harrell C > 0.60 with lower 95% CI > 0.50; high-vs-low HR > 1 with p < 0.05; calibration slope near 1
external_plan.groups: primary split at the frozen TCGA median lp; within-cohort median split reported as sensitivity
external_plan.also_report: RNA component alone and clinical component alone, HR per SD, Uno C at 5y
